title: 第2章
content_zh: 第2章 出山多天下来，楚子风已经熟习了岩洞的每一个角落，并且还在岩洞中找到了一种野果做为食物，每天吃饱肚子后就开始修炼“青木帝皇诀”。也不知道为什么，当楚子风按照白玉碑上的方法刚开始修炼的时候，就已经感觉到在自己的体内有一股微小的气在流动，起先的时候楚子风并不太在意，可随着楚子风的身体越来越强壮，甚至可以举起一块五十斤的石头在岩洞中青蛙跳时，楚子风不的不去想，自己的身体到底是怎么回事，虽说修炼会使的自己的身体强化，但这才几天的时间，应该还达不到任何的效果才对呀。“难道是那些乳白色的水跟那条小蛇的关系？”想起刚到岩洞时所中的两种毒，随即自己一冷一热，跑到了石室中，楚子风这才明白过来，原来是那些乳白色的水跟那条火红色的小蛇无意间帮了自己，两种毒素在自己的体内相互碰击，最后融合为了一体，并且在自己的体内形成了一股气，使的自己修炼起来有事半功倍的效应。只不过，那乳白色的水到底是什么水？那条火红色的小蛇又是什么蛇？为什么两者结合起来，会对自己有利无害呢，楚子风却不知道！想不通的事情楚子风不想浪费时间去想，又再过了五天的时间，借着体内所拥有的那股气，楚子风很快就进入了粹体初期的境界。这个时候，楚子风已经可以举起一块六十斤的石头了，并且还在水池与石室之间的路上来回的做青蛙跳，只不过现在每跳出十几米，楚子风都要休息一会，然后再接着跳，这就是楚子风的修炼方法，也是白玉碑上所记载的初期修炼方法。到了第十五天，楚子风在岩洞中又找到玄天大帝留下来的一些字，这才明白，原来自己刚来到这所喝下的那种乳白色的水叫寒冰水，根本就不是什么毒水，而是一种可以除去人体毒素的水，但刚喝下的时候身体会变的很麻木；而那条火红色的小蛇名为火龙蛇，是天地间的一种奇兽，相传是蛟龙的后代，经过无数岁月的衍变，除了头上的独角之外，早已经失去了蛟龙的特性，不可能化身为真龙，还带有无比强烈的剧毒，一但被此蛇所咬，那就算是大罗神仙都会挂，好在楚子风先喝了寒冰水，再被火龙蛇所咬，这寒冰水又是排毒之水，火龙蛇从楚子风的血液中吸了寒冰水，将它本身的毒全部化去，无毒的火龙蛇自然就枯萎了，而寒冰水跟火龙蛇的毒素，却在楚子风的体内形成了一种全新的力量，反而帮了楚子风一把。第二十天，现在的楚子风已经可以举起一块八十斤的石头，在岩洞中青蛙跳的距离也是越来越远了，而且还没有感觉到丝毫的累，脸色红润，缠绕着他多年的病魔仿佛被驱赶出体外，再也不会缠着楚子风不放了。整整一个月下来，楚子风的修为已经到达了粹体中期，而“青木帝皇诀”似呼也已经练成了一半。“奇怪了，这‘青木帝皇诀’是玄天大帝平身最强大的功法，不应该这么快就能练到如此地步呀……难道是寒冰水跟火龙蛇的关系，使的我修炼加倍，‘青木帝皇诀’也在这么短的时间内练成了一半？”其实楚子风自己都不知道在玄天洞府中已经呆了一个月的时间，在这个不见天日的地方，也根本就分不清时间，楚子风觉得修炼的差不多了，就会趟在白玉碑前睡觉，睡醒了再修炼，这样一天天的下来，却已经过了一个月。到了第二个月，楚子风的修为已经到达了粹体后期，可以举起一百斤的石头在岩洞内来回的做青蛙跳了，半路上根本就不需要任何的休息跟停留。砰，砰，砰。岩洞内的响声正是楚子风在修炼，粹体的修炼方法就是以力量去强化修炼者的身体，加上在这里除了岩石之外没有其他可修炼的东西，所以这两个月下来，楚子风只能添加岩石的重量，不断的做青蛙跳。呼……嘭……楚子风从石室举着一百斤的岩石跳到水池前时，将岩石朝水池那边一丢，只听岩洞中“砰”的一声，岩石与岩壁相互碰撞，岩洞内一阵微震，被楚子风丢过去的岩石裂成了十几块小岩石。“不会吧，我居然变的这么厉害了！”楚子风都不敢相信自己的眼睛，自己的力气居然变的如此之大，一百斤的岩石说丢就丢，说碎就碎了，现在的自己，还是自己吗！楚子风根本就没有发现，现在的自己早已经不是两个月前的自己了，不单单是将缠着自己十八年的病魔给除去了，力气变大了，就连体形也发生了翻天覆地的变化。楚子风现在有着一米八的身高，全身的肌肉非常发达，但皮肤却十分白净，仿如刚刚出生的婴儿般，吹弹可破。“试试‘青木帝皇诀’吧，看看有没有突破。”楚子风将体内所形成的强大力量运行了起来，早在体内形成的那股力量开始游动，楚子风双拳一握，纵身而起，在岩洞的半空中连续好几个翻身，人已经来到了岩壁前，双拳猛的朝岩壁打了过去，只见两个由白气所形成的拳头，同时打在了岩壁之上。砰……岩洞内又是一阵震动，一块块的碎石朝周围冲去。楚子风翻身落地，看着自己刚才所打的岩壁，在那岩壁上居然出现了两个深深的洞，楚子风双连一眨也没眨，惊道：“这是我做的吗？这也太厉害了吧，我居然可以在岩壁上打出两个这么深的洞，难道，我的‘青木帝皇诀’已经练成了。”“青木帝皇诀”是玄天大帝最为强大的功法，但却不是说刚练成的时候就有着多大多大的威力，而是随着修炼者本身的修为高低而变化的，也就是说，楚子风的修为越高，“青木帝皇诀”的威力就会越大。山中无日月，时光飞逝，这已经是楚子风在岩洞中度过的第三个月了。这天，楚子风盘膝坐在了白玉碑前，运行着体内的功法，只感觉到一股外在的气从自己的天灵盖进入自己的体内，并且全部集中在了自己的丹田处，不到一分钟的时间，丹田处所聚集的气分散在了全身的每一个穴位上，并且还在不停的游走全身，与自己体内原本的那股力量融合为了一体，形成了一股全新的力量，也可以说是一股气，而这股气，就是传说中的真气。在楚子风的周围一层层的真气遍布着，地上无数的小石头全部躁动，随着楚子风的功法运行的越来越快，地面上的小石头居然全部渐渐升了起来，在楚子风的周身不停的转动着。经过了一个小时，楚子风将体内的真气又再聚集到了丹田处，这个时候，楚子风缓缓睁开了眼睛，只感觉自己体内的真气越来越强大了起来，于是楚子风站起身，举起了一块两百斤的岩石，脚下一动，楚子风身形如箭，在石室的岩壁上快如山电般跳跃着，不带丝毫的吃力，就跟做一件非常普通的事情似的。“突破了，我终于突破了粹体后期，进入了养气境界，终于可以离开这里，回家去了。”也不多想，白玉碑上的一切，楚子风已经深深的记在了脑海中，就算没有这块白玉碑，楚子风同样可以自行修炼，现在要做的就是尽快离开这里，回到外面的世界去。楚子风走到了石室以南边的岩壁前，再次将体内的真气运行了起来，“砰”的一声，楚子风双掌打在了岩壁之上。吱……被楚子风所打的岩壁发出一阵阵“吱吱”的声音，无数的碎石从石室上掉落了下来，岩壁上突然出现了一道缝隙，强烈的眼光，从缝隙之外射了进来，照射着楚子风的双眼。万龙山没有任何的变化，毒辣的阳光依然是没有丝毫怜悯的照射着大地，万龙瀑布的水还是那么急。当楚子风经历了三个月的时间，再次出现于万龙山时，却身在山峰之巅的一块巨石前，巨石上出现了一道石门，这，便是玄天洞府的出口。“原来我不是在山的底下，而是在整座山的中心位置。”将石门给关闭了起来，这也是按照玄天大帝的意思，不让任何人发现玄天洞府的存在。楚子风立于山峰之巅，深深的吸了口气，身上的衣服还是三个月前的那套，可却已经是破烂不堪了，头发林乱，活像个野人。“哈哈，现在可以回家了。”楚子风身影一动，在山峰之巅留下了一个残留，人已经朝山下冲了下来，就如一块圆石般，脚下没有片刻的停留，更加没有按照山路而行，借着山中的岩石跟树木，左蹦右跳，穿过了一片树林，不出十秒钟，人已经来到了山下的一片田地上。楚子风心急着回家，下了山后也没有停留，再次纵身而起，在田地上仅仅落了三次地，便来到了一座石桥前，这座石桥名为归乡桥，也就是Z市的入口，而在石桥之上，挂着一块由中国移动通讯制造的牌子，上面写着：“Z市欢迎您”。
content_en: Chapter 2 After many days in the mountain, Chu Zifeng has become familiar with every corner of the cave. He also found a kind of wild fruit in the cave as food. After eating every day, he began to practice the "Aoki Emperor Technique". I don’t know why, but when Chu Zifeng started practicing according to the method on the white jade tablet, he already felt a tiny stream of Qi flowing in his body. At first, Chu Zifeng didn’t pay much attention to it, but as Chu Zifeng’s body became stronger and stronger, he even... When he could lift a fifty kilogram stone and jump in the cave, Chu Zifeng couldn't help but think about what was going on with his body. Although practice would strengthen his body, it should not have any effect after only a few days. "Is it the relationship between the milky white water and the little snake?" Thinking of the two poisons he had taken when he first arrived in the cave, and then he was hot and cold, and ran into the stone chamber, Chu Zifeng realized that it was the milky white water and the fiery red snake that had unintentionally helped him. The two toxins collided with each other in his body, and finally merged into one, and formed a Qi in his body, which made his practice more effective with half the effort. But, what kind of water is that milky white water? What kind of snake is that little fiery red snake? Chu Zifeng didn't know why combining the two would be beneficial to him and harmless! Chu Zifeng didn't want to waste time thinking about things that he couldn't figure out. After another five days, with the energy in his body, Chu Zifeng quickly entered the realm of the early stage of the pure body. At this time, Chu Zifeng could already lift a sixty-pound stone, and he was still doing frog jumps back and forth on the road between the pool and the stone room. However, every time he jumped more than ten meters, Chu Zifeng would take a rest before jumping again. This was Chu Zifeng's training method, and it was also the initial training method recorded on the white jade tablet. On the fifteenth day, Chu Zifeng found some words left by Emperor Xuantian in the cave. Only then did he realize that the milky white water he drank when he came here was called cold ice water. It was not poisonous water at all, but a kind of water that could remove toxins from the human body. It is plain water, but your body will become very numb when you first drink it; and the fiery red snake is called the Fire Dragon Snake, which is a strange beast in the world. According to legend, it is the descendant of the dragon. After countless years of evolution, except for the single horn on its head, it has long lost its The characteristics of a dragon make it impossible to transform into a real dragon, and it also contains extremely strong poison. Once bitten by this snake, even a great god will die. Fortunately, Chu Zifeng drank the ice water first, and then was bitten by the fire dragon snake. This ice water is also a detoxifying water, and the fire dragon The snake sucked the ice water from Chu Zifeng's blood and removed all its own poison. The non-poisonous fire dragon snake naturally withered. However, the toxins of the ice water and the fire dragon snake formed a brand new power in Chu Zifeng's body, which actually helped Chu Zifeng. On the twenty-first day, Chu Zifeng could already lift an eighty-pound stone, and the frog jump distance in the cave was getting farther and farther, and he did not feel tired at all. His face was rosy, and the illness that had plagued him for many years seemed to have been driven out of the body and would no longer haunt Chu Zifeng. After a whole month, Chu Zifeng's cultivation has reached the middle stage of pure body, and the "Aoki Emperor Technique" Sihu has been halfway completed. "It's strange. This 'Aoki Emperor Technique' is the most powerful technique in Emperor Xuantian's life. It shouldn't be possible to practice it to such an extent so quickly... Could it be that the relationship between the ice water and the fire dragon snake made me double my practice, and half of the 'Aoki Emperor Technique' was completed in such a short period of time?" In fact, Chu Zi Feng himself didn't know that he had been staying in Xuantian Cave for a month. He couldn't tell the time in this dark place. Chu Zifeng felt that he was almost done practicing, so he would go to sleep in front of the white jade monument and wake up to practice again. In this way, a month had passed day by day. By the second month, Chu Zifeng's cultivation had reached the late stage of pure body. He could lift a hundred kilograms of stone and perform frog jumps back and forth in the cave without any need for rest or stop along the way. Bang, bang, bang. The sound in the cave was that Chu Zifeng was practicing. The pure body cultivation method is to use strength to strengthen the practitioner's body. In addition, there is nothing else to practice except rocks. Therefore, in the past two months, Chu Zifeng could only add the weight of rocks and continue to do frog jumps. Huh... bang... When Chu Zifeng jumped from the stone room to the pool with a hundred kilograms of rock, he threw the rock towards the pool. There was a "bang" in the cave. The rock collided with the rock wall. There was a slight earthquake in the cave. The rock thrown by Chu Zifeng cracked into more than a dozen small rocks. "No way, I have become so powerful!" Chu Zifeng couldn't believe his eyes. His strength had become so great. A hundred kilograms of rock could be thrown away and broken into pieces at a moment's notice. Is he still himself now? Chu Zifeng didn't realize at all that he was no longer the same person he was two months ago. Not only had he gotten rid of the disease that had plagued him for eighteen years, his strength had become stronger, and his body shape had also undergone earth-shaking changes. Chu Zifeng is now 1.8 meters tall, with very well-developed muscles all over his body, but his skin is very fair, like a newborn baby, and can be broken by a blow. "Try the 'Aoki Emperor Technique' and see if there is a breakthrough." Chu Zifeng activated the powerful force formed in his body, and the force that had been formed in his body began to swim. Chu Zifeng clenched his fists, jumped up, and turned over several times in mid-air in the cave. He had already arrived in front of the rock wall, and punched the rock wall with both fists. Only two fists formed by white gas were seen.
